title: Target app refs to resolve
description: A non-empty array with one entry per application window to resolve into a target app definition file.

ref.description: Top-level snapshot ref from the rendered tree: 'w<N>' for a window, 'b<N>' for a browser. Any other ref kind fails the entry.

definitionFilePath.description: Absolute path of the target app definition file to write, with forward slashes (a backslash is a JSON escape). A relative path resolves against the CLI working directory, not --project-dir.

name.description: Display name of the target application.

examples.name: Acme HR Portal
examples.description: The main login page of the Acme HR portal
